discovery_start.description: Whether to start discovery automatically when iscsid starts

timeout_login_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for login to complete before timing out

timeout_logout_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for logout to complete before timing out

auth_retry.description: Maximum number of authentication attempts per connection

discovery_auth_username_in.description: CHAP incoming (target-to-initiator) username for mutual CHAP

discovery_auth_password_in.description: CHAP incoming (target-to-initiator) password for mutual CHAP

name.description: Optional target name; if omitted, computed from portal/port

portal.description: Target portal IP address or hostname

enabled.description: Enable CHAP authentication for this target

iface_ip.description: Static IP address to bind the iSCSI interface to (optional)

iface_hwaddress.description: Hardware MAC address of the network interface to bind (e.g., '00:11:22:33:44:55')

session_max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous connections per session (multipath)

node_session_initial_login_retry_max.description: Number of retries during initial login before giving up

node_session_cmds_max.description: Maximum number of commands per session

node_conn_max_xmit_data_length.description: Maximum transmit data segment length in bytes

node_conn_max_recv_data_length.description: Maximum receive data segment length in bytes

iscsi_offload.description: Enable hardware iSCSI offload (requires supported HBA)

node_session_err_timeo_abort_timeout.description: Seconds to wait before aborting commands during error recovery

node_session_err_timeo_reset_timeout.description: Seconds to wait before resetting the connection during error recovery

node_session_err_timeo_fast_io_fail_time.description: Seconds before marking paths as failed (fast I/O fail)

node_session_recovery_tmo.description: Seconds to wait before giving up on session recovery
